heading: 6.3 Unmet Needs
credit: Source: 2026 Rio Grande Regional Water Plan (Region M), Ch. 6, p. 6-5

paragraphs.text: Region M does not have municipal unmet needs.
However, the Irrigation and Mining non-municipal water user groups (WUGs), as detailed below, do have unmet needs.
As detailed in Table 6-2, if Region M experiences extensive drought years, irrigation would exhibit unmet needs.

The water rights system in the Amistad-Falcon Reservoir system is structured such that municipal water rights are protected, and irrigation water rights have lower reliability in years of limited supply.
Limited supplies in the reservoirs may occur because of drought or because of a deficit in deliveries from Mexico under the 1944 treaty governing the Rio Grande/Rio Bravo.
